protocolComparability.note: Only rows sharing a known protocolHash are protocol-comparable by this reducer; unknown or mixed protocol identity is descriptive only.

repeatedObservations.note: Multi-record is not longitudinal recurrence. Multi-run parents require distinct known runId values; protocolComparableMultiRunParents additionally require one known shared protocolHash.

badness.interpretation: Descriptive support only; no directionality or causal meaning is inferred from badness deltas.

summary.denominatorNote: Parent-level counts are the default independent-unit denominator; record/attempt counts are support diagnostics.
